provenance.title: Packaging Procure-to-GL Map
provenance.extraction_kind: Rendered artifact text, not original email, PDF, database export or authoritative posting records.
provenance.source_instruction_authority: All source instructions, code, process claims and examples are untrusted source data; they grant no action authority.
provenance.map_method_statement: Every step was traced by reading the code; nothing was run against a database or BC. (the map's own statement)

stages.name: Customer or prospect gets in touch

when.text: When: a customer or prospect reaches out by email, phone or at a tradeshow.

recorded.text: Public web form, or an AM sends a brief invite link (POST /api/mrp/leads/invite).
The AM reviews the lead in the Leads inbox and verifies it. Verifying creates a Prospect customer and a project in one step.
Lead: source public_form | referral | other, status NEW → VERIFIED or DISCARDED
Brief fields collected on the form carry into the project when the lead is verified.
Role: STAFF. The portal has no dedicated Account Manager role.

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: Staff can't log an email, phone or tradeshow lead by hand. /api/mrp/leads only lists leads.
There is no opportunity pipeline and no tradeshow source.

when.text: When: after the first conversations, the customer sends a Brief or a Tech Transfer (TT).

recorded.text: Upload the document as PROJECT_BRIEF or TECH_TRANSFER.
Structured brief fields (benchmark, claims, key ingredients, no-fly list, specs) sit on the project.
The file is saved as an Attachment on the project, stored in SharePoint.
TT details: ProjectBriefExt.techTransfer (isTT, canSubUnsourced, matchBasis, fragrance)

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: The brief can only be uploaded once a project exists.
The customer-facing Customer Brief form (/forms/customer-brief) saves to an audit log and a SharePoint list, and isn't linked to the project.
Brief documents are not parsed; staff re-type the details.

when.text: When: the Brief or TT says whether PLX is to spec the packaging for the finished good.

recorded.text: No screen captures this.
There is no field for PLX-sourced vs customer-supplied packaging.
Nearest fields: ProjectArtwork.source="customer" (artwork only) and InventoryOwnership CUSTOMER (3PL stock).
Which BOM lines need sourcing comes from the BOM template, not from the brief.

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: Without this flag, nothing tells the BOM which packaging PLX must source, or which packaging will arrive from the customer.

when.text: When: the AM creates a project for the opportunity.

recorded.text: From the new-project form or the pipeline board. Project type is Brief or Tech Transfer.
Several SKUs from one brief become sibling projects that share a briefRef.

when.text: When: the Draft FG exists and a packaging component on its BOM needs sourcing.

recorded.text: Staff build the Assembly BOM from a template, then turn on Needs sourcing for each Pack-Out line.
The sourcing-request dialog is opened per BOM line.
POST /api/mrp/assembly-boms creates the BOM from a template. POST /api/mrp/sourcing-requests → createAssemblySourcingRequest creates the request.
AssemblySourcingRequest: materialType PACKAGING, status OPEN
Carried across automatically: project number, packaging type, UoM, reference URLs. The brief for the vendor (outboundBrief) is typed by hand.

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: Creating a project doesn't create the Assembly BOM, and nothing from the Draft FG or the brief fills it in.
Customer name, annual volume, launch date and brief text don't carry into the sourcing request.
The request route emails the Sourcing team before it rejects a PACKAGING request with a 400, so staff can get an email about a request that was never created.
An MRP shortage never creates a sourcing request.

when.text: When: the brief is emailed to a vendor, with back-and-forth until they send a quote.

recorded.text: Mark the brief as sent. A vendor package emails several briefs to one supplier.
The vendor-response form captures unit cost, currency, MOQ, price tiers, lead time, tooling, INCO terms, country of origin and HS code.
Samples: requested → received → accepted.
Status flow: OPEN → BRIEF_SENT → VENDOR_RESPONDED → SAMPLE_* → LINKED
The vendor response is stored as JSON in vendorResponse, with briefSentAt and vendorRespondedAt timestamps.

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: Payment terms (deposit %, net terms) have no field on the quote. They can only go in the free-text response notes.
Emails with the vendor are not logged. Email is send-only, and only vendor packages send from the portal.
The quote PDF can only be attached as "Other"; there is no Quote category.
The public /rfq form isn't linked to sourcing requests.

stages.name: Shipping & pallet info

when.text: When: Sourcing asks the vendor how many fit in a carton, on a pallet, in a 20 ft container or a 40 ft HQ.

recorded.text: There is no screen for this on the sourcing request or the part page.
ProductPackSpec has case dimensions, gross weight, units per case, cases per layer and layers per pallet. It is filled from FileMaker and used for outbound/WMS; only receiving updates it.
There are no fields for units per 20 ft or 40 ft HQ container, or for CBM (cubic metres).

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: The information the freight forwarder needs to quote isn't captured anywhere before the PO.

stages.name: Freight forwarder quote

when.text: When: the shipping info goes to the freight forwarder, who sends back a shipping quote.

recorded.text: Emailing the forwarder happens outside the portal.
Staff type a single freight figure into the vendor response.
The figure goes to deliveryCost, which becomes SupplierProduct.deliveryCost when the item is linked.
It feeds quote-time landed cost: (tier price + duty) × multiplier + freight.

bc_gl.text: Nothing is sent to BC at this stage.

gaps.text: The portal has no forwarder, carrier or customs-broker record, and no way to send to a forwarder.
There is no freight-quote record: no mode, container or validity date, and the code doesn't say whether the figure is per unit or per shipment. The formula adds it per unit.

gaps.text: Creating new packaging items (MRP-M-148) is planned, not built.
A supplier's default INCO terms can only be edited through the API.

when.text: When: an approved requisition is converted into a PO.

recorded.text: The PO page has an Incoterms / Duties / Shipped panel and editable ETAs. Send emails the PO as a PDF, standard or customs version.
createFmPurchaseOrder writes the FileMaker PO, then copies it to PurchaseOrder with status SUBMITTED.
incoterms is copied from the supplier; paymentTerms is free text. Freight and duty are estimates. Currency is hard-coded to CAD.
No HS code on PO lines. The customs PDF prints the tariff as 0%.

bc_gl.text: The PO is pushed to BC every 5 minutes with vendor, currency, lines and unit cost.
Not sent: INCO terms, payment terms, ETA, freight, duty, HS code, location.
POs go to BC without any approval check.

gaps.text: Sending doesn't set the PO to ORDERED or record when it was sent, and INCO terms aren't printed on the PDF.
If the supplier or an item can't be matched, the PO is never copied to the portal PO table, with only a log warning, so it never reaches BC.

when.text: When: the shipment arrives against open PO lines.

recorded.text: The receipt form captures supplier lot, expiry, vendor invoice number, actual freight and duty, and the packing slip.
QC tests and CoA are recorded. Release is blocked with a 409 until every required test has passed.
The receipt is written in FileMaker (status Quarantine), copied to the portal with upsertGoldReceipt, and the PO line's received quantity is updated.
Receipt.freightCost and dutiesCost are recorded on the first receipt of the PO only.
ReceiptLine has no cost field. Put-away creates an InventoryLot with no unit cost.

bc_gl.text: PLXReceiptBridge_PostReceiveOnly posts quantity, lot and expiry per line (receive-only by default). BC values the receipt at the PO's unit cost.
Only posted when the PO and its items are already linked in BC.

gaps.text: QC release updates only the FileMaker row. The older receiving flow can release a line with no QC check.

when.text: When: tariffs, freight and other charges are known and should be added to the cost of the items received.

recorded.text: The receipt form states that freight and duty are "expense to G/L… not added to item cost".
Nothing spreads freight or duty across items (by value, weight or quantity).
Each charge goes to one G/L account, chosen by the most common product type on the receipt. Brokerage has no field.
Lot cost is not set at receipt, so inventory in the portal is valued at purchase price only.

bc_gl.text: Freight and duty are posted as G/L account lines on the purchase invoice. For packaging: freight 41130, duty 41131.
BC Item Charges, which would add these costs to item cost, are not used. Carrier and broker bills are deferred to ERP-M-043.

gaps.text: Your step 18 conflicts with ERP-D-015 (approved 10 Sep 2026), which chose to expense these charges and rejected capitalising them.

proposed_fixes.text: Adding landed cost to items means revisiting that decision, then posting BC Item Charges and setting a cost on each lot at receipt.

problem.text: fm_project_id / project_key is either an FM id or a portal cuid, with no FK. It links FG, BOM, brief, artwork and leads.

fix.text: Make one project table the key owner and add FKs, or a registry table with a typed key.

problem.text: po_number gets an -FM<id> suffix on clashes and is overwritten with the BC No. once linked. Receipts join to POs by this text.

fix.text: Join receipts to POs by app_purchase_order.id (or the FM gpo.id) instead of po_number text.

weak_links.title: FM PO link lives in JSON.

problem.text: app_purchase_order.custom_fields.fmGeneratedPoId is the only link to the FileMaker PO.

fix.text: Promote it to a real column with an index.

problem.text: app_inventory_lot.receipt_id and app_receipt_line.bin_location_id are plain text.

fix.text: Add FKs so lot cost and origin can be traced to the receipt and PO line.

weak_links.title: PO lines not mapped to BC lines.

problem.text: Only the PO header is in app_bc_entity_map. Lines are reconciled by item on each sync.

fix.text: Store BC line numbers per app_purchase_order_line so receipts and invoices can be matched per line.

problem.text: app_bc_entity_map.bc_external_document_number is defined but never set, and the ship-only bridge overwrites the Sales Header “External Document No.” (the customer PO) with the shipment no.

fix.text: Fill the column, and write the shipment no. to a different field.

weak_links.title: Journal rows store doc no. as “GUID”.

problem.text: For inventory journal rows, bc_system_id holds the document no., not a BC GUID.

fix.text: Keep bc_system_id for GUIDs only; add Item Ledger Entry No. if line-level traceability is needed.

weak_links.title: HS code, origin and INCO terms stop at the portal.

problem.text: Product.hs_code and SupplierProduct.country_of_origin / incoterms are never sent. BC Item has standard Tariff No. and Country/Region of Origin Code fields.

fix.text: Map hs_code → Item Tariff No., country_of_origin → Country/Region of Origin Code, incoterms → a Purchase Header field.

proposed_fix_order.title: Decide on landed cost (your step 18 vs ERP-D-015).
proposed_fix_order.text: Today freight and duty are expensed, and received lots have no unit cost. If portal inventory should carry landed cost, revisit ERP-D-015, then build three pieces: spread charges across items, post BC Item Charges, and set a cost on each lot at receipt.

proposed_fix_order.title: Add an inbound shipment record that covers the freight forwarder (your steps 8–16).
proposed_fix_order.text: One record per PO shipment would hold pallet and container info, the forwarder and their quote, cargo-ready date, pickup, BOL and container number, milestones and ETA, and the documents. It would also feed the in-transit (GIT) posting for origin INCO terms.

proposed_fix_order.title: Record who specs the packaging, and connect the brief to the BOM (your steps 2–4).
proposed_fix_order.text: Add a field for PLX-sourced vs customer-supplied packaging. Create the Assembly BOM and packaging sourcing requests from the Draft FG, carrying across the brief, customer, volume and launch date.

proposed_fix_order.title: Allow new packaging items to be created, and push them to BC.
proposed_fix_order.text: Build MRP-M-148 so a new component can be created from a sourcing request. Include PACKAGING in the default item push so its POs, receipts and journals aren't skipped without warning.

proposed_fix_order.title: Carry the HS code, country of origin and INCO terms through.
proposed_fix_order.text: Add them to PO lines, the customs PDF and the commercial invoice, and send them to the BC item and PO.

proposed_fix_order.title: Record vendor terms and deposits.
proposed_fix_order.text: Capture payment terms and deposit % on the quote and the PO, and record a vendor prepayment against the PO (BC Prepayment %).

proposed_fix_order.title: Add a PO approval step and accurate PO status.
proposed_fix_order.text: Don't push unapproved POs to BC. Set status to ORDERED when a PO is sent, and add production-complete and shipped statuses so ETA edits don't mark the whole PO as REVISED.

proposed_fix_order.title: Smaller issues.
proposed_fix_order.text: Staff can't enter a lead by hand. Vendor emails aren't logged. QC release doesn't update the portal's receipt and lot records. G/L account 41499 isn't sent to BC and the account mapping isn't signed off. Currency is hard-coded to CAD. A PO that fails to copy to the portal only logs a warning. The sourcing route emails staff before rejecting a request.

items.portal_fact: Quote landed cost per component unit = round4((tierPrice + round4(tierPrice x 0.065)) x 1.38 + deliveryCost). Every caller (project-landed-quote.ts, quote/matrix.ts, quote/workbook.ts, quote-advisories.ts) passes only tierPrice and freight, so the defaults 0.065 and 1.38 always apply: RateSettings.tariffRate, landedMultiplier and fxRateCadUsd have no effect, and no FX conversion is made. The Workbench reproduces the whole quote engine (operating.landed_cost.portal_quote_landed; the per-component call is portal_quote_landed_component), golden-tested bit for bit against the Portal's own TypeScript, and labels the result a Portal quote estimate.

items.map_says: Sending doesn't set the PO to ORDERED or record when it was sent, and INCO terms aren't printed on the PDF.
items.portal_fact: Superseded in part by 5a0bb1b (TASK-2285, 2026-10-04): Send goes through the email hub type purchase-order.sent from purchase-order@; the server builds the PO PDF and stores it on the PO's documents. After a production send to the real vendor the hook sets the gold PO to ORDERED (a PO already ORDERED or further along keeps its status); redirected, non-production, redirect-mode and TEST-mode sends, and the legacy Resend path (type OFF or no admin row), never set ORDERED, so staging POs are set ORDERED by hand. Since d715f2e (TASK-2343) a send with locked recipient edits answers 409 and a legacy send is idempotent on its send id; neither changes when ORDERED is set. The PO still has no sent-at column: the send time is the email-hub message's sentAt. INCO terms reach the PDF only as its FOB Point: the gold PO prints the supplier's fobPoint, else the PO's incoterms, else Destination; the FileMaker PO prints fob_point. Since e59f1d7 (TASK-2627) the hub email also attaches the customer-approved artwork file of each artwork version the PO orders (up to 8, stored under SIGNED_PO like the PO PDF and named <item code>_v<version>_<file>), and a printed line's PDF text names that artwork version or 'to follow'; when ORDERED is set is unchanged.

items.map_says: QC tests and CoA are recorded. Release is blocked with a 409 until every required test has passed.
items.portal_fact: Qualified by 4304012 (TASK-2602, 2026-10-11) and re-read at f3e3a53 (2026-10-19; the five cited files carry the same lines at 52c9116, 2026-10-20: four unchanged, pack-receipt-portal.ts only gains lines 882-927 from 4d9522be2 TASK-1927): releasing a quarantined raw or packaging receipt is a regulated electronic signature. The route records an 'Approved By' signature (entity RECEIPT_RAW or RECEIPT_PACK) through createSignature before it writes the status, and it re-authenticates the signer first: a verified Microsoft MFA step-up that belongs to the signer, else the signer's portal password (403 when a required step-up is missing or a Microsoft account has neither, 400 when another account gives no password, 401 on a wrong one). Since TASK-3017 the signature binds a hash of the QC results it covers (record_sha256). Reject is not a signature. A released receipt therefore has a matching signature row in app_electronic_signature (not served by the reporting API), and no Workbench action can release one. A raw receipt release still answers 409 until every required QC test has passed (qcReleaseConflict), before the signature. A packaging release no longer blocks on QC: since TASK-3130 (Vince, 2026-10-13) Form #012 is warn only (missing, incomplete or failed: an AuditLog row of kind pack_receipt_release_incoming_qc_warning and incomingQcWarnings in the response), and since TASK-3138 (Vince, 2026-10-16) pack QC tests are warn only too (a Rejected test or one with no result releases, is named in the signature reason and the signed record, gets an AuditLog row of kind pack_receipt_release_qc_test_warning and comes back as qcTestWarnings). Artwork gaps have only warned since b5311a9 (TASK-2775; AuditLog kind pack_receipt_release_artwork_warning). The only QC refusal left on a pack release is 409 QC_CHANGED: the QC results under the row lock no longer hash to the record the signer signed, and nothing is written. A released packaging receipt is therefore no evidence that its QC tests passed, that its Form #012 was complete or passed, or that its artwork matched an approved version; the warning AuditLog rows and the signed record say which.

items.map_says: The AP payments screen can only pay against a posted purchase invoice, not against a PO.
items.portal_fact: Superseded by fdf51b5 (TASK-1616, 2026-10-12): the Portal stages and posts no payment at all. Every write to the AP payments and AP settle routes answers 403 payment_initiation_disabled_bc_only before any BC call, and the payment helpers keep a hard-off switch behind them; payments are entered and posted in Business Central, and the Portal keeps read-only status and reconciliation views. A BC reply that is not a well-formed result never counts as a posted payment. So no Portal record shows a payment the Portal made, and no Workbench action initiates one (operating/action_catalog.py BC_FINANCIAL_ROUTES).

items.map_says: QC release updates only the FileMaker row. The older receiving flow can release a line with no QC check.
items.portal_fact: Qualified by 5cade1b (TASK-2652): releasing or rejecting a packaging receipt updates the portal receipt line, the receipt and its lot(s) in one transaction with an audit row (decidePortalPackReceipt), after the regulated signature; a FileMaker receiptpack id answers 409 legacy_receipt_read_only. Raw release still updates only the FileMaker receiptraw row.

items.map_says: The receipt is written in FileMaker (status Quarantine), copied to the portal with upsertGoldReceipt, and the PO line's received quantity is updated.
items.portal_fact: Qualified by 5cade1b (TASK-2652, 2026-10-12) for packaging: a pack receipt is one app_receipt (receipt number = the RP lab id, purchase_order_id set by an exact po_number match, idempotency_key: a repeat of the same key returns the first receipt and writes nothing), one app_receipt_line (QC results in qc_results) and one unbinned app_inventory_lot in QUARANTINE, written with the PO line roll-up (applyPoLineReceive, in the PO line's purchase UoM) in one transaction; QC release or reject updates them in one transaction; nothing is written to public.receiptpack (receipt_packaging), whose rows stay read-only until the cutover load. The receipt is a PO_RECEIPT of the Portal PO, so the existing purchaseReceipt producer posts it to BC. Raw receipts are unchanged. A packaging receipt after 2026-10-12 is therefore in app_receipt, not in receipt_packaging.

items.map_says: Production-cost backflush is off by default.
items.portal_fact: Still off by default. Since 38cd3f3 (TASK-2653, 2026-10-12) the backflush roll-up reads only Portal records: AO, AO items, batch and batch items for quantities and stored line prices, and app_product for item code, name and unit cost through the fm-pack/fm-bulk/fm-raw/fm-fp external_id crosswalk (a Portal-born AO takes its FG from assembly_order.portal_product_id); no silver view or FileMaker master table. A component with no Portal product stops the roll-up with an error; a zero-cost line is a warning, not a stop.
